description.zh: 功能配置ID，多个ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。ConfigId查询和使用，请参见[ConfigId使用说明](~~388994~~)。
description.en: The configuration IDs. Separate configuration IDs with commas (,). For more information about ConfigId, see [Usage notes on ConfigId](~~388994~~).

description.zh: 您的加速域名，多个域名使用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持50个域名查询。
description.en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify up to 50 domain names in each request. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).
